hypothesis: Weight of plaice at fixed length follows a seasonal cycle, falling from about November to March or April and recovering by November, matching the spawning season.
pass_criterion: Fulton condition factor of plaice, after controlling for length, has a minimum in Feb-Apr at least 10% below the Aug-Nov maximum, and the minimum coincides with the peak of spawning-stage maturity records.
fail_criterion: Seasonal amplitude below 3%, or minimum falls outside Jan-May, or it does not coincide with the maturity peak.
interpretation: Condition factor stands for weight at fixed length. Spawning as sole cause is tested only by coincidence with maturity stage, not shown causally.

dataset.name: DATRAS (the Database of Trawl Surveys)
dataset.publisher: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES)
dataset.why_it_fits: Quarterly surveys with length, weight and maturity records for plaice, though I did not confirm the exact fields.
